{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[Cultural Properties of Japan|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site
