{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

{{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

[[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

[[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

[[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

[[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

[[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] [[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] [[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the [[:en:Prefectures of Japan|Urban Prefecture]] of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been [[:en:Cultural Property (Japan)|designated]] as being of national [[:en:Values (heritage)|significance]] (including two *[[:en:List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|Special Historic Sites]]); the Tombs of [[:en:Chikamatsu Monzaemon|Chikamatsu Monzaemon]] cross the prefectural borders with [[:en:Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo]].{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*[[:en:Osaka Castle|Ōsaka Castle]] Site

the Tombs of {{ill|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|en|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|WD=Q324986|lt=Chikamatsu Monzaemon}} cross the prefectural borders with {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|WD=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo}}.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*{{ill|Osaka Castle|en|Osaka Castle|WD=Q321242|lt=Ōsaka Castle}} Site

the Tombs of {{ill|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|en|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|WD=Q324986|lt=Chikamatsu Monzaemon}} cross the prefectural borders with {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|WD=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo}}.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*{{ill|Osaka Castle|en|Osaka Castle|WD=Q321242|lt=Ōsaka Castle}} Site

[[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] [[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] [[en:List of Historic Sites of Japan (Osaka)]][[fr:Liste des sites historiques du Japon (Osaka)]] {{short description|None}} {{GeoGroup}} This list is of the '''Historic Sites of Japan''' located within the {{ill|Prefectures of Japan|en|Prefectures of Japan|WD=Q50337|lt=Urban Prefecture}} of '''Ōsaka'''.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/shuppanbutsu/bunkazai_pamphlet/pamphlet_en.html |title=Cultural Properties for Future Generations |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}} ==National Historic Sites== As of 17 June 2022, seventy-one Sites have been {{ill|Cultural Property (Japan)|en|Cultural Property (Japan)|WD=Q858308|lt=designated}} as being of national {{ill|Values (heritage)|en|Values (heritage)|WD=Q7912786|lt=significance}} (including two *{{ill|List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|en|List of Special Places of Scenic Beauty, Special Historic Sites and Special Natural Monuments|WD=Q20982902|lt=Special Historic Sites}}); the Tombs of {{ill|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|en|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|WD=Q324986|lt=Chikamatsu Monzaemon|1=Chikamatsu Monzaemon}} cross the prefectural borders with {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|WD=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo|1=Hyōgo Prefecture}}.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*{{ill|Osaka Castle|en|Osaka Castle|WD=Q321242|lt=Ōsaka Castle|1=Osaka Castle}} Site

the Tombs of {{ill|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|en|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|WD=Q324986|lt=Chikamatsu Monzaemon|1=Chikamatsu Monzaemon}} cross the prefectural borders with {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|WD=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo|1=Hyōgo Prefecture}}.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*{{ill|Osaka Castle|en|Osaka Castle|WD=Q321242|lt=Ōsaka Castle|1=Osaka Castle}} Site

the Tombs of {{ill|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|en|Chikamatsu Monzaemon|qid=Q324986|lt=Chikamatsu Monzaemon|1=Chikamatsu Monzaemon}} cross the prefectural borders with {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo|1=Hyōgo Prefecture}}.{{cite web |url=https://www.bunka.go.jp/seisaku/bunkazai/shokai/shitei.html |script-title=ja:史跡名勝天然記念物 |trans-title=Number of Monuments of Japan by Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |date=1 June 2022 |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://kunishitei.bunka.go.jp/bsys/index |title=Database of National Cultural Properties: 史跡名勝天然記念物 (史跡, 特別史跡 大阪府 2県以上) |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Agency for Cultural Affairs]] |access-date=20 June 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/bunkazaihogo/bunkazai/kensuu.html |title=府内の指定文化財件数表 |trans-title=Number of Cultural Properties in the Prefecture |language=Japanese |publisher=[[Osaka Prefecture]] |date=11 March 2021 |access-date=20 June 2022}} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="width:100%;" |- !width="30%" align="left" | Site !width="10%" align="left" | Municipality !width="30%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Comments !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| image !width="10%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Coordinates !width="5%" align="left" | Type !width="5%" align="left" class="unsortable"| Ref. |- | align="center"|*{{ill|Osaka Castle|en|Osaka Castle|qid=Q321242|lt=Ōsaka Castle|1=Osaka Castle}} Site
